## Description

/care/overdue: tasks past due with days late and reminders delivered; Escalate to doctor creates an inbox item for the responsible clinician; Reassign; Close with reason. SLA timers per task type.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Escalation creates an inbox item and notification for the responsible clinician within 1 minute.
- [ ] **AC2.** Overdue lists sort by severity and days late; filters by owner.
- [ ] **AC3.** Closing an overdue task requires a reason and is audited.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
